description: One conversation in full: every message of the simulated or real user and every reply of the agent, in order; the verdict on the conversation (clean, or the problems it has); and each problem with its explanation, its suggested fix and the quotes that show it. A quote from the agent's configuration names the source it is in (knowledge_source: the id get_source takes, and the version quoted). When the agent's turns were traced, each reply carries what the agent did: its tool calls with their arguments and results (long ones cut in the middle) and its model calls by name; what the trace withheld reads as withheld. Use it to understand a problem before changing the agent's code or prompt. include_trace false leaves the steps out.

conversation.description: The conversation's id, as list_problems shows it under 'conversation'.
conversation.title: Conversation

include_trace.description: Include what the agent did on each turn, from its trace. False leaves it out.
include_trace.title: Include Trace

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project
